description: Which environment variables are removed from a spawned ACP agent's environment: the exact names CLAUDECODE and CLAUDE_PID, and every name with the prefix CLAUDE_CODE_ (Swift's hasPrefix, whole clusters). Names are compared case-sensitively. The PATH augmentation is the platform's and is not in this table.
function: ACPAdapter.agentEnvironment(from:), the scrub half ↔ powerup_core::harness::acp::environment::is_scrubbed — input: a variable name; expected: true when it is removed
verifiedBy: Swift: ACPFixtureTests.testAcpEnvironmentTable runs ACPAdapter.agentEnvironment(from:). Rust: rust/powerup-core/tests/acp.rs acp_environment_cases runs harness::acp::environment::is_scrubbed.
capturedAgainst: ACPAdapter.swift's agentEnvironment(from:) as of dddf9c6 (Swift 5.9.2, macOS 27.2)

cases.name: CLAUDECODE is removed
cases.reason: HK-127: the Claude bridge refuses to run inside a Claude Code session (verified live 2026-08-27), so the nesting markers are removed from the agent's environment.

cases.name: CLAUDE_PID is removed
cases.reason: HK-127: the Claude bridge refuses to run inside a Claude Code session (verified live 2026-08-27), so the nesting markers are removed from the agent's environment.

cases.name: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID is removed
cases.reason: HK-127: the Claude bridge refuses to run inside a Claude Code session (verified live 2026-08-27), so the nesting markers are removed from the agent's environment. Every CLAUDE_CODE_ variable goes.

cases.name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT is removed
cases.reason: HK-127: the Claude bridge refuses to run inside a Claude Code session (verified live 2026-08-27), so the nesting markers are removed from the agent's environment. Every CLAUDE_CODE_ variable goes.

cases.name: the bare prefix is removed
cases.reason: HK-127: CLAUDE_CODE_ itself has the prefix.

cases.name: CLAUDE_CODE without the underscore is kept
cases.reason: HK-127: the prefix ends with an underscore.

cases.name: a longer name than CLAUDECODE is kept
cases.reason: HK-127: CLAUDECODE and CLAUDE_PID are exact names, not prefixes.

cases.name: a name ending in CLAUDECODE is kept
a lowercase claudecode is kept
cases.reason: HK-127: names are compared case-sensitively, as macOS does.

cases.name: a lowercase prefix is kept
cases.reason: HK-127: the prefix is case-sensitive too.

cases.name: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is kept
cases.reason: HK-127: only the nesting markers go; the user's Claude configuration stays.

cases.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is kept
cases.reason: HK-127: credentials the agent may need stay.

cases.name: a combining mark after the prefix is kept
cases.reason: HK-063, HK-127: Swift's hasPrefix compares whole clusters, so an underscore that a combining acute follows is not the prefix's underscore (captured on the Swift statics).

cases.name: a zero width joiner after the prefix is kept
cases.reason: HK-063, HK-127: a joiner extends the underscore's cluster too (captured on the Swift statics).

cases.name: a combining mark after an exact name is kept
cases.reason: HK-063, HK-127: CLAUDECODE with a combining acute on its last letter is another name.
